title: Average speed calculation
description: Essential: The student's final answer for average speed must be 4 m/s.

title: Average velocity calculation
description: Essential: The student's final answer for average velocity must be 0 m/s.

title: Correct distance for speed
description: Important: The student must use the total path length (200 m) in the average speed formula.

title: Correct displacement for velocity
description: Important: The student must recognize that displacement is zero for a closed loop and apply it to the average velocity formula.

title: Distinguishing speed and velocity
description: Important: The response must clearly differentiate between the scalar (speed) and vector (velocity) quantities.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The final answers should include correct units (m/s).

title: Confusing speed with velocity
description: Pitfall: Award a penalty if the student gives the same numerical answer for both parts, confusing the two concepts.

title: Incorrect time or distance
description: Pitfall: Award a penalty if the student uses an incorrect value for time (not 50 s) or distance (not 200 m) in a calculation.
